meta.description: Build complete Nature-style Chinese PPTX presentation from scientific paper with evidence-led story, key figure selection, Chinese slide content and speaker notes. Classifies paper type (discovery, methods, resource, clinical, materials, review) with narrative arcs, runs 9-step workflow (read → classify → plan → select figures → extract assets → write content → build PPTX → self-review → verify), enforces quality gates (figure crop validation, alignment checks, text overflow detection, de-templated expression), uses python-pptx toolchain.

scientific_integrity.detail: Does not fabricate results, numbers, or figure details. Figures selected as evidence (not decoration) with prioritization logic. Terminology Ledger maintains consistency. Self-review loop with severity grading enforces quality.

practice_boundaries.detail: Appropriate scope for presentation building. Evidence-grounded approach with hero evidence first, narrow interpretation rail. Anti-template design avoids generic phrasing. Speaker notes for detailed explanation.

methodological_ground.detail: Paper-type classification drives presentation arc (question-to-evidence, problem-to-solution, workflow-to-validation, design-to-inference, property-to-mechanism, evidence-map). Visual rhythm planning sound. Figure-crop self-check prevents information loss.

code_usability.detail: Working toolchain (python-pptx). Audit script (audit_pptx_quality.py) detects shape bounds, text overflow, AI-template wording, crop issues, alignment near-misses. Asset manifest for traceability.

functional_suitability.note: Comprehensive presentation workflow: paper-type classification (6 types with narrative arcs), 9-step workflow (read, classify, plan, select figures, extract assets, write content, build PPTX, self-review, verify), Chinese slide content with speaker notes, figure extraction and cropping, terminology ledger, programmatic quality audit (audit_pptx_quality.py). Handles journal club, group meetings, thesis seminars, defense decks.

reliability.note: Excellent quality gates: figure-crop self-check prevents panel letter/axis/legend/scale bar removal, text overflow detection prevents clipping, alignment checks catch near-misses, self-review loop with severity grading (high/medium/low), audit_pptx_quality.py programmatic validation. Terminology Ledger ensures consistency. Two-pass reading strategy (metadata/abstracts first, then results/methods).

performance_context.note: Efficient progressive loading: only selected paper-type arc loaded (not all 6), design/figure/self-review references on-demand. Default slide count guidance (12-16 for 15-20 min, 10-14 for quick). Asset manifest tracks 4-8 selected figures (not all). Two-pass reading focuses on needed pages.

agent_usability.note: Clear 9-step workflow with explicit purposes. Paper-type classification before design (user can correct cheaply). Visual rhythm planning prevents single-layout-family decks. Evidence hierarchy (design/workflow, main evidence, validation, mechanism, implication). Anti-template design guidance. Minor: lacks explicit decision tree for interdisciplinary papers straddling multiple types.

human_usability.note: Strong Chinese-by-default language rule. Evidence-grounded expression (no template phrases like '一句话总结', '最有价值的后续方向'). Speaker notes for oral explanation. Source labels on figure slides. Contact sheet for cropped assets. QA report (qa_report.md) documents issues and resolutions. Bilingual triggers (论文做PPT, 论文汇报, 组会PPT, 文献汇报).

security.note: No fabrication of results or figure details. Does not invent missing numbers, mechanisms, datasets. Asset traceability with manifest. Terminology Ledger prevents inconsistent translations. Python-pptx toolchain safe (no arbitrary code execution). Output directory structure controlled.

maintainability.note: Excellent modular design: core principles/toolchain/workflow/output-quality stable, six paper-type arc fragments, on-demand references (design-and-layout, figure-assets, self-review). Shared terminology-ledger from nature-shared. Audit script external and updatable. Version 2.0.0 shows active maintenance.

agent_specific.note: Strong evidence-led design: figures as evidence not decoration, hero evidence first, narrow interpretation rail. Self-review loop with severity grading. Terminology Ledger for consistency. Minor: no explicit token budget management for very long papers (100+ pages). Visual rhythm planning sophisticated but lacks automatic layout diversity enforcement (agent must apply manually). No batch mode for generating multiple variants (short/long, technical/general).

recommendations.title: Add automatic layout diversity enforcement in audit script
recommendations.problem: Visual rhythm planning documented with composition-type guidance and 'avoid repeating same role/composition too often' rule, but no automatic enforcement. Agent must apply manually. No programmatic layout-diversity check in audit_pptx_quality.py to catch violations.
recommendations.root_cause: Diversity principle documented in references/design-and-layout.md but not operationalized in validation tooling.
recommendations.fix: Add to audit_pptx_quality.py: --check-layout-diversity that: (1) extracts slide layouts (hero-left, full-image, grid, timeline, etc.) from shape geometry/count, (2) counts consecutive same-layout runs, (3) flags WARNING when >3 consecutive slides use same layout, (4) flags ERROR when >60% of deck uses single layout family. Include layout-type fingerprinting heuristics (image-dominant vs text-dominant vs balanced). Document threshold tuning.

recommendations.title: Add decision tree for interdisciplinary paper classification
recommendations.problem: Paper-type classification instruction says 'pick arc matching dominant argument' for interdisciplinary papers but lacks explicit decision tree. Agent must infer which aspect is dominant without clear criteria when paper straddles multiple types (e.g., methods + discovery, clinical + materials).
recommendations.root_cause: Manifest provides detect hint but no decision tree for hybrid cases.
recommendations.fix: Add references/paper-type-decision-tree.md with: (1) flowchart: start with 'What is the central question?' → if 'How does X work?' → discovery, if 'How to achieve X?' → methods, if 'What are X properties?' → materials, if 'Does intervention X affect Y?' → clinical, etc.; (2) hybrid threshold: use primary arc when >60% of slides support that narrative, otherwise escalate to user for clarification; (3) examples for common hybrids (AI model + dataset → methods primary if model novel, resource primary if dataset novel). Reference from manifest detect section.

recommendations.title: Add batch mode for generating presentation variants
recommendations.problem: Workflow generates single presentation optimized for one audience/duration. No guidance for generating multiple variants from same paper (short 5-min version for lab meeting, detailed 30-min version for seminar, general-audience version with less technical detail). User must request separately and manually consolidate.
recommendations.root_cause: Single-task workflow design. Batch/variant generation not considered.
recommendations.fix: Add references/variant-generation.md documenting: (1) variant types (short/long, technical/general, defense/seminar), (2) slide-selection rules for each variant (short: 6-8 slides, key figures only; long: 16-20 slides, all evidence; general: simplified terminology, more background), (3) batch generation script that: reads base plan, applies variant filters, generates multiple PPTX files. Include variant manifest tracking which slides belong to which variant. Optional: parallel generation with subagents.
